label: lem:composite_generated_early
title: A composite is generated before its own outer iteration
statement:
Let $m\ge 2$ be composite, and let $p$ be its least prime factor.
    Write $m = ap$.
    Then $a < m$, and when the sieve processes the outer index $a$, the inner loop reaches the prime $p$ and writes $\mathrm{lp}(m):=p$.
proof: Since $m$ is composite, $p < m$, so $a = m/p \ge 2$ and $a < m$. By \ref{lem:lpf_monotone_along_decomp}, $p \le \mathrm{lp}(a)$, so the inner loop visits $p$. By \ref{lem:write_correct}, the write is correct.
